description: With capital losses and no capital gains the business/nonbusiness split can't change Form 172 (lines 2–4 and 11–15 give the same line 22), so it isn't asked. Single 2025: interest $3,000, $3,000 capital loss deducted, no wages: line 1 −15,750; line 9 15,750 − 3,000 = 12,750; line 22 $3,000 → line 24 $0, no NOL.
